statements.t: “Importantly, the enthusiastic response from the medical community to the strength and consistency of the data demonstrate the significant unmet need in PBH, and we look forward to building on this momentum with the upcoming presentation of LUCIDITY data at ObesityWeek this month.
We remain on track to submit our NDA by year-end and are executing on our comprehensive commercial readiness plans ahead of a potential launch of avexitide in 2027, if approved.
A live audio webcast of the call will be available under “Events and Presentations” in the Investor section of the Company’s website, https://investors.amylyx.com/events-presentations.

dropped.t: “With the last participant’s final study visit recently completed, we are eagerly anticipating the expected topline data readout of the pivotal Phase 3 LUCIDITY trial in post-bariatric hypoglycemia in late August or early September,” said Joshua Cohen and Justin Klee, Co-CEOs of Amylyx.
We look forward to sharing updates as we work toward potentially delivering the first FDA-approved therapy for the PBH community.”
